listing.name: Diablo / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: Native Diablo PlayStation recompilation from Alexbeav’s PSXRecomp project.

steps.title: Prepare the Mac toolchain and setup kit
steps.instruction: Install Xcode Command Line Tools, CMake, Ninja and Python 3. Verify that the tools are on PATH, then unpack the official Intel or Apple Silicon ZIP that matches your Mac into a separate writable folder.

steps.title: Supply your original files
steps.instruction: Use your original single-track European SLES-01156 disc. This kit requires your own retail SCPH-5552 BIOS dump. Follow the kit’s README-SETUP.txt for the image format and BIOS options.

steps.title: Build and add the prepared player
steps.instruction: From the unpacked folder, run Diablo_Recompiled and follow its Generate & rebuild wizard. In Portcove, select build-release/Diablo_Recompiled as the program and build-release as the start folder. Keep the external runtime and use upstream instructions for replacement.

warnings: Mac setup uses the upstream kit and your local toolchain. Mac build, gameplay and populated saves remain unobserved.

references.title: Updates and backups
references.instruction: Preserve the entire working folder with its saves, settings, overlay captures, original disc files and any required BIOS. Keep a copy of the creating runtime before updating the kit.

presentation.manual_preparation: Provide your own matching single-track CHD for Diablo Europe SLES-01156 and legally obtained retail SCPH-5552 BIOS. OpenBIOS is not an accepted substitute for this release. Portcove uses its registered Python/build toolchain for managed preparation and skips the setup launcher when playing. Generation, runtime, lifecycle and gameplay are untested. Preserve the title GPL-3.0-only, framework PolyForm Noncommercial and UI MIT notices; no rights to retail game data or generated retail content are inferred. Linux x86-64 uses the pinned managed build toolchain; the packaged setup host requires GLIBC 2.29, GLIBCXX 3.4.26 and OpenGL. Generated-game minimum-host compatibility and Linux runtime behavior remain untested.
